faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Scientist position at IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Scientist position at IIT Gandhinagar is 18th September 2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Ph.D. or equivalent in Electronics, Physics, Materials Science, Materials Engineering, or a related field. Alternatively, an M.Tech./M.S. or equivalent with at least 2 years of post-qualification experience is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Scientist position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,25,000, depending on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Scientist position at IIT Gandhinagar as per the advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Project Scientist position at IIT Gandhinagar must be submitted through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Project Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Scientist role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening of applications, followed by shortlisting based on the candidate's CV and Statement of Purpose (SOP).

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Scientist position at IIT Gandhinagar is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: The official website of Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is https://www.iitgn.ac.in. You can visit this site for more information about the institute and its activities.
